method: Static full NDJSON/JSON parity review of current species corpus and consumers, plus spot verification using user-uploaded Core PDF pp.31-32 and Core/Clone Wars searchable text. Not a book-by-book certification or live Foundry test.

findings.name: Twi'lek
findings.source: Saga Edition Core Rulebook printed p.32, Twi'lek species traits
findings.evidence: Book and pack canonicalTraits have Great Fortitude +2 species Fortitude, Deceptive reroll and Low-Light Vision. data/species-traits.json structuralTraits instead contains Graceful (+2 Reflex) and Persuasion Training (+5 Persuasion). SpeciesTraitPassiveAdapter.registerFromActor considers structuralTraits plus canonicalTraits for PASSIVE registration; source-incompatible bonuses could enter derived stats.
findings.action: Surgical sidecar mechanics correction and regression; confirm no double application through ledger and passive adapters.

findings.name: Wookiee
findings.source: Saga Edition Core Rulebook printed p.32, Wookiee species traits
findings.evidence: Pack and Core rules grant +4 STR +2 CON, Rage and other traits; sidecar structuralTraits has Endurance '+2 species Fortitude Defense' not granted by Core Wookiee race. SpeciesTraitPassiveAdapter may register that bonus.
findings.action: Remove or correctly source noncanonical +2 Fortitude on the executed sidecar only after checking later source expansions; regression verify racial ability modifiers are not double-counted.

findings.name: Republic Clone
findings.source: Clone Wars Campaign Guide Republic Clone Species Traits section (text transcription); source says one chosen ability score +2
findings.evidence: Fixed score array and bonusValue=2 are correct. But abilityChoice metadata declares allocationMode='level-4-two-abilities', maxPerAbility=1, and helpText instructs two +1 increases. build-pending-species-context sets selected ability +2 for a single selection, so the data/UI model is internally contradictory; actual end-to-end UI outcome untested.
findings.action: Align chooser UI/schema with one +2 choice, preserve existing valid selected +2 computation, test preview and final actor scores.

findings.name: Supplemental 30 species
findings.evidence: 30 of 161 species have no entry in the 131-species canonical statistics corpus. These are supplemental, not necessarily incorrect. Most also lack structured canonicalTraits/description.
findings.action: Book-by-book source/page certification, then selective repairs. Do not delete supplemental species wholesale.

findings.name: Trait sidecars
findings.evidence: Both migrated sidecar rules and the non-migrated sidecar passive adapter participate in runtime behavior. 25 species have differing membership between pack canonicalTraits and sidecar canonicalTraits, largely legacy supplemental species; membership difference is not per se erroneous. Distinct legacy structural traits also exist for many core species.
findings.action: Prove deterministic winner and no double or invented effects; test passive/activated and ledger results against book for representative species.

findings.name: Species provenance
findings.evidence: 58 species have no system.source; no source-page field was found in pack schema census. Provenance must not be inferred from prior ambiguous wiki data.
findings.action: Add verified source/page fields via discrete source-backed provenance audit, without overwriting selected variants.

findings.name: Species descriptions
findings.action: Backfill concise player descriptions from verified printed rules; avoid inventing setting lore.

findings.name: Natural weapon grants
findings.source: Saga Edition Core Rulebook Wookiee entry; packs/species.db naturalWeapons
findings.evidence: Six species contain explicit natural weapon data. Wookiee has a Claws 1d6 slashing weapon, while Core lore disapproves use of climbing claws in combat; later supplements may differ. Do not conclude mechanical illegality from cultural narrative alone.
findings.action: Verify each of six species against relevant source text, Foundry item materialization and attack workflow.

findings.name: Activated traits / primitive / droid builder
findings.evidence: Some mechanics are deliberately deferred (Ithorian Bellow application, Aleena Energy Surge expiry, Clawdite reaction window) and constrained builder behavior needs in-Foundry smoke tests. Tests not executed during this census.
findings.action: Representative Foundry tests for Human, Twi'lek, Wookiee, Republic Clone, Shard, Replica Droid, primitive and a variant species.
